summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running tests or repository code, per instructions. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs; exported via __all__, not re-exported from widgets/__init__.py); UnderlineBar now builds one Text object with clickable_ranges click spans (clickable_ranges is 4th input, width 5th; early path returns before click spans); Opacity merges blended color into existing style so meta is preserved; layout resolver Edge docstring documents size/min_size/fraction defaults; docs/reference/tabs.md added; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py (existing tests unchanged) and tests/test_tabs.py. Choices: bar position is a full-list index mapped to displayed label ranges by name so duplicate names work; zero-width labels get no layout edge; watcher skips animation on the initial assignment; letter search only for single-character keys; sandbox demo skipped as optional. Not verified: nothing was run, so the new and existing tests are unverified, and the auto-fit label test depends on hand-computed flexible shares (24, 25, 24, 25). Nothing is committed.
